title: Governed AIAS Capability Factory
purpose: Turn approved blueprints into registered, certified and reusable AIAS capabilities through the unified Development Platform.
scope: Blueprint contracts, atomic registry, immutable identity, sequential evidence gates, specification compilation, development delegation, validation, releases and lifecycle events.

requirements.title: Blueprint contract
requirements.statement: Capabilities shall declare identity, owner, approval, requirements, architecture and ADR references.
requirements.rationale: Make capability intent complete and reviewable.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Lifecycle gates
requirements.statement: Only sequential DRAFT through RELEASED transitions with target evidence shall be accepted.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Immutable registry
requirements.statement: Stable capability identities shall reject conflicting blueprint replacement and persist atomically.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Governed production
requirements.statement: The factory shall compile a specification and delegate production to DEV-PLATFORM-001.
requirements.rationale: Reuse the certified production control plane.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Immediate consumer
requirements.statement: A reference BIM wall-schedule capability shall reach RELEASED through the real Development Platform.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Reproducible delivery
requirements.statement: The factory shall include tests, documentation, installer, checksums and release.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

risks: Generated engineering output requires human review.
